name: @prismical/swift-helper
description: Swift native helper for accessibility APIs and system integration

scripts.build: node -e "if (process.platform !== 'darwin') process.exit(0); else require('child_process').execSync('pnpm --filter @prismical/types generate:all && turbo run build:native', {stdio: 'inherit'});"
scripts.build:native: node -e "if (process.platform !== 'darwin') process.exit(0); else require('child_process').execSync('mkdir -p .build && swift build --configuration release && mkdir -p bin && cp .build/release/SwiftHelper bin/SwiftHelper', {stdio: 'inherit'});"
scripts.dev: node -e "if (process.platform !== 'darwin') process.exit(0); else require('child_process').execSync('pnpm --filter @prismical/types generate:all && swift build --configuration debug && mkdir -p bin && cp .build/debug/SwiftHelper bin/SwiftHelper', {stdio: 'inherit'});"
